Do not adopt the original artwork's frontal symmetrical wingspan. Match image 3's skin markings, bony wing spars, pointed scalloped membrane edge, lean torso and long shallow curved beak. INVARIANTS: same canvas dimensions 1536 x 1024, camera, framing, subject scale and rightward side view.
